title: Meet the martial eagle, the apex predator of Mikumi National Park
desc: MIKUMI National Park is often regarded as the fourth largest park in Tanzania, spanning over 3,230 square kilometres. Situated approximately four hours’ drive from Dar es Salaam, it lies near the town of Morogoro. The park is bordered to the south by Nyerere National Park and is surrounded by the scenic Uluguru and Udzungwa Mountains.
